subtasks.title: Install Vitest and create configuration
subtasks.description: Install vitest and @vitejs/plugin-react as dev dependencies. Create vitest.config.ts with jsdom environment, path aliases matching tsconfig. Add 'test' and 'test:watch' npm scripts.
acceptance_criteria: npm test runs vitest with no test files found (exit 0)

subtasks.title: Write unit tests for utils.ts
subtasks.description: Test slugify() with: normal titles, special characters, leading/trailing whitespace, very long titles, empty strings. Create tests/unit/utils.test.ts.

subtasks.title: Write unit tests for TaskStore
subtasks.description: Test TaskStore: create task appears in getAll, phase defaults to backlog, update modifies fields, updatePhase changes phase and writes events.jsonl, getById finds by id, delete removes directory. Use temp directory for isolation.

subtasks.title: Install Playwright and create E2E config
subtasks.description: Install @playwright/test as dev dependency. Create playwright.config.ts targeting localhost:3000. Add 'test:e2e' script.
acceptance_criteria: npx playwright test --list shows the test file

subtasks.title: Write E2E test for Kanban board
subtasks.description: Create tests/e2e/kanban.spec.ts: navigate to localhost:3000, verify page title/header, verify kanban columns are visible, click a task card and verify task detail panel opens.
acceptance_criteria: E2E test navigates to kanban page and verifies basic UI elements
